# Command-line reference

<!-- generated by docs/gen_cli.py from config_enum.cli.build_parser; do not edit by hand -->

`config_enum [options]` and `python config_enum.py [options]` take the same options.
Every option except `--input`, `--save_input`, `--help` and `--version` can also go in an input file (see [Input files](input_files.md)); the file key is the long name without dashes (e.g. `noDopants`) or the short name (e.g. `nd`).


## Input and output

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-i`, `--inpf` |  | Input file(s), any file type compatible with ASE. |
| `-o`, `--outf` |  | Output file name. Def: Automatic naming: e.g. config_ID. |
| `-it`, `--itype` |  | Input file type. Def: determined automatically from the extension. |
| `-ot`, `--otype` | `res` | Output file type, default: .res (SHELX format) |
| `-od`, `--odir` | `OUT-FILES` | Output directory (kept for compatibility; not used: the output is written to StepX/input_N folders). |
| `-ow`, `--overwrite` |  | overwrite if output folder exists. Def: No |
| `-rs`, `--restart` |  | Do a continuation run (all converged VASP calculations will be read in and will not be redone). Def: No |
| `-iseed`, `--inpseed` |  | Seed name for reading the CASTEP .param and .cell files in order to use the settings within. |
| `-sf`, `--sepfol` |  | to save geometries in separate folders (e.g. for VASP runs). Default: all output of an input structure is written in the same directory. |

## Structure and symmetry

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-prim`, `--ifPrim` |  | use the primitive cell instead of supercell (requires SPGlib installed). Highly recommended for computational efficiency. Def: false |
| `-ref`, `--initCrysFile` |  | File for obtaining the initial crystal site (symmetry) information. Can be any type that ASE supports; it must have the same cell and atom order as the structure to be doped. Def: same as the input file (-i) |
| `-tol`, `--tol` | `0.001` | The symmetry tolerance. Def: 1e-3 |
| `-nosymm`, `--nosymm` |  | switch off the use of symmetry info, e.g. equivalent sites (not recommended). |
| `-r`, `--rep` |  | Repeat the input structure in a, b, c directions to get a supercell, e.g. -r 2 2 1 |

## Sites and dopants

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-nl`, `--list` |  | atom list(count starts at 1); e.g. -nl 1,2,5,8:12 |
| `-at`, `--aType` |  | atom type to be included in enumeration; e.g. -at Na Li |
| `-wl`, `--wycklist` |  | List of Wyckoff positions of crys. sites to include in enumeration. A list of available sites can be obtained via dry run (-dry); e.g. -wl 24d 12a |
| `-excl`, `--excludelist` |  | List of crystal sites (atom indices) to exclude from the configuration enumeration (these atoms will not be considered even though selected by -nl, -at or -wl earlier).  e.g. 1:4 24  for [1,2,3,4,24], atom numbering starts at 1. |
| `-dexcl`, `--dopeexcluded` |  | Add dopant/vacancy to the atoms/crys-sites given in the excluded list (in all configurations). This option is good for doing iterative vacancy/dopant addition with the previous knowledge of lower dopant/vacancy compositions. Def: False. |
| `-dt`, `--dType` |  | Dopant type to consider in the enumeration; This can be an atom symbol (e.g. Na) or vacancy (e.g. Va) |
| `-dexcl_type`, `--dexcl_type` |  | Dopant type to consider for the sites given in the excluded list (see -dexcl keyword for details). Def: equal to dType |
| `-nd`, `--noDopants` |  | (List of) number of dopant/vacancy to consider in enumeration; e.g. 0:4 24  for 0,1,2,3,4 and 24 vacancies) |

## Modifications, interstices and final checks

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-mod`, `--modify` |  | To make some final touches on the configurations selected for enumeration. You can combine multiple modifications using multiple statements separated by ';', the order of the statements will be strictly followed. This is a useful option to do necessary modifications to compensate for the dopant effect  e.g. balancing the total system charge  by deleting additional (nearest) cations upon introducing higher-valence cation(s). The reference can be an atom type or 'dopant' (the doped/vacant sites). Def: No additional modifications.  Example usage: -mod 'replace all within 2 of Al with Va' or -mod 'remove Li nearest 1 of dopant'. |
| `-ai`, `--addint` |  | To add the interstices as X atoms (select them with -at X) based on the Wyckoff positions data for the reference symmetry group. Default: False. |
| `-ase`, `--ASE_symm` |  | Do a final check of the symmetrically-unique configurations by comparing the whole structures with ASE (SymmetryEquivalenceCheck). Default: False. |

## Energies: VASP, CASTEP and CASM files

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-castep`, `--castep` |  | Run quick, low-accuracy CASTEP calculations to estimate the configuration energies. Default: a simple ASE potential (see -pot) is used. |
| `-vasp`, `--vasp` |  | Use VASP to compute configuration energies. Inputs (INCAR, KPOINTS, POTCAR) are read from the input directory (-id) |
| `-vexe`, `--vaspexe` | `vasp_std` | Vasp executable. Def: vasp_std |
| `-cexe`, `--castepexe` | `castep.mpi` | CASTEP executable. Def: castep.mpi |
| `-casm`, `--casm` |  | to create prim.json and config_list.json files for CASM. Default: False. |
| `-copy`, `--copyinp` |  | to copy the files contained in "INPUTS" folder (with -sf). Default: False. |
| `-id`, `--idir` | `INPUTS` | Input directory to copy the files from, default: INPUTS |
| `-mp`, `-makepotcar`, `--makepotcar` |  | to compile POTCAR (for VASP) using actual atomic content. The environment variable ($VASP_PP_PATH) should be defined beforehand. Default: False. |
| `--potcarxc` | `potpaw_PBE` | XC functional to use in making of POTCAR. Def: potpaw_PBE |
| `-xc`, `--xc` | `pbe` | Exchange correlation functional to use (pseudopots will be selected accordingly, e.g. LDA, PBE,PBEsol, etc. Def: PBE |
| `-hubU`, `--hubU` |  | For defining the Hubbard U parameters (in eV) for specific atom and orbital types, e.g. -hubU Fe d 2.7, Sm f 6.1 |
| `-mgm`, `--magmoms` |  | Magnetic moments for a collinear calculation. Eg, 'Fe 5.0 Nb 0.6 O 0.6' Def.: None. If a defined element is not present in the POSCAR, no MAGMOM will be set for it. |

## Parallelisation

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-np`, `--nprocs` | `32` | No of processes to start for each CASTEP/VASP calculation through srun/mpirun. Def:32 |
| `-nt`, `--ntasks` | `1` | No of calculations (tasks) to run simultaneously. Def:1 |
| `-nn`, `--nnodes` | `1` | No of nodes to run CASTEP/VASP runs through srun. Def:1 |
| `-mpi`, `--mpirun` |  | Use mpirun for parallel runs. Default: srun is used |

## Thermodynamics and sequential doping

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-t`, `--temp` | `298.15` | Temperature at which the configurational thermodynamics is computed. Def: 298.15K |
| `-seq`, `--seq` |  | If to run an automated sequential doping to reach the target number of dopants (-nd): the number of dopants/vacancies added at each step. The configurations are selected at each step based on energy/symmetry (--seqtype). Def: 0 (no sequential doping; all dopants are added at once). |
| `-spick`, `--seqpick` | `1` | How many configs to pick at each step in a sequential doping. Def: 1 |
| `-stype`, `--seqtype` {E,S,D,R} | `E` | How to sort the configurations at each step of  a sequential doping. Options: 'E': Based on Energy (low-energy configs are picked); 'S': based on symmetry (highest-symmetry configs picked); 'D': config(s) with highest degeneracy are picked; 'R': configs are picked randomly. Def: 'E'  |

## General

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-v`, `--verb` |  | Verbose output. Default: False. |
| `-dry`, `--dry` |  | Dry run to get the equivalent (Wyckoff) positions. Default: False. |
| `-noskip`, `--noskip` |  | Do not skip problematic configs (and assigning them with 0 energy and P1 symmetry). Default: Bad configs are skipped. |
| `-ssym`, `--seqsymm` {current,ref} | `current` | Symmetry operations used after the first step of a sequential doping: 'current': those of the current (doped) structure; 'ref': those of the Step 1 (reference) structure, as in the original script (fewer configurations, but inequivalent ones can be merged). Def: current |
| `--wyckoff_file` |  | File with the Wyckoff positions of the space groups, needed for -ai. Def: $CONFIG_ENUM_WYCKOFF or $HOME/wyckoff.dat |
| `-q`, `--quiet` |  | Only show warnings and errors. Default: False. |
| `--version` | `==SUPPRESS==` | show program's version number and exit |

## ASE calculators (simple and machine-learning potentials)

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-pot`, `--ase_pot` {LJ,Morse,EMT} | `LJ` | Simple potential of ASE used if none of -vasp, -castep and --mlip is given (for quick tests only; LJ and Morse do not distinguish the atom types). Def: LJ |
| `-opt`, `--optimise` |  | ASE/MLIP: optimise the geometry of each configuration (Def: single-point energies). The structures passed on to the next step of a sequential doping are always the unoptimised ones. |
| `--fmax` | `0.05` | ASE/MLIP: force convergence criterion of the geometry optimisation. Def: 0.05 eV/A |
| `--steps` | `200` | ASE/MLIP: max number of geometry optimisation steps. Def: 200 |
| `--optimiser` {BFGS,FIRE,LBFGS} | `BFGS` | ASE/MLIP: ASE optimiser. Def: BFGS |
| `--relax_cell` |  | ASE/MLIP: also relax the cell in the geometry optimisation (implies -opt). Def: False |

## Machine-learning potentials

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-mlip`, `--mlip` |  | Use a machine-learning potential to compute the configuration energies: mace, mace-off, chgnet, matgl, sevennet, orb, fairchem, nequip, allegro, or custom:package.module:function (any function returning an ASE calculator). Def: none |
| `--mlip_model` |  | Model name or path for --mlip, e.g. 'medium-mpa-0' or 'my.model' (MACE), '7net-0' (SevenNet), 'uma-s-1' (fairchem). Def: the backend default |
| `--device` | `auto` | Device for the machine-learning potential: cpu, cuda, mps or auto. Def: auto (GPU if available) |
| `--mlip_kwargs` |  | Extra keyword arguments for the ML potential calculator as a Python dict, e.g. "{'default_dtype': 'float32'}" or "{'task_name': 'omat'}". Def: none |

## Input files

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--input` |  | Input file (TOML, YAML or JSON) with options; keys are the long option names (e.g. inpf, aType, dType, noDopants). Options given on the command line override the file. |
| `--save_input` |  | Write the effective options of this run to a TOML/YAML/JSON file (by extension) that can be used with --input. |
